title: Affine ANEC selects the closed FRW branch for geodesically complete cosmology
summary: We study the relation between geodesic completeness, the averaged null energy condition (ANEC), and spatial curvature in Friedmann--Robertson--Walker (FRW) cosmology within classical general relativity. Using the affinely parameterized ANEC along radial null geodesics, we prove that non-static flat or open FRW spacetimes in the regular classes considered here cannot be both null geodesically complete and ANEC-satisfying.
